Management explanation: Customer IMMEX registration delay; customers ramping their own Mexico lines.

body: Ashish Garg (MD) on 2025-08-11 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "Because right now, we are in a phase where it is coming up and the CAPEX will get finished by, say, second quarter or third quarter of next financial" Metric: Heavy-component plant completion. Target: by Q3FY27 (Dec-2026). Deadline: 2026-12-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-22: moved-goalpost. Evidence: 2025-11-07 'will probably start from third quarter of next year'; 2026-02-10 'on track ... as per the schedule', utilisation 'some bit from FY28'; 2026-05-22 'by end of FY27 we expect to complete our large capex ... trials early FY28'; 2026-11-06 'going as per the scheduled timelines ... expected to be completed and commence operation in the quarter four of FY2028'. Five quarters later than first stated while each call says 'on schedule' - a silent goalpost move. Scored before the Dec-2026 deadline because the company's own latest date makes it unreachable.
